name: Weather
description: The weather at the device's location: now, the next hours, the next days. One page per view. The API key, units and kept answers are the OpenWeatherMap settings.

properties.name: views
properties.title: Views
properties.description: One page per view, in this order: the weather now, the next day in steps of three hours, the next days. Two or three views make a slot of that many pages. The place is the device's location (System settings).

properties.name: title
properties.title: Title
properties.description: The heading above each page. Empty: the place's name.

properties.name: fontSize
properties.title: Text Size
properties.description: The size of the text on the page.
